text: {"contradictions":[],"omissions":[],"additions":[{"english":"The examples of Ajamila, Prahlada, Dhruva, Gajendra, and others are well-known. And the scripture says: \"No evil ever befalls the devotees of Vasudeva.\""}]}

additions.english: The examples of Ajamila, Prahlada, Dhruva, Gajendra, and others are well-known. And the scripture says: "No evil ever befalls the devotees of Vasudeva."
